# superset_dashboard (Resource)

Manages a dashboard in Superset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_dashboard" "example" {
  dashboard_title = "Example Dashboard"
  published       = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dashboard_title` (String) Title of the dashboard.

### Optional

- `css` (String) Optional custom CSS applied to the dashboard.
- `json_metadata` (String) JSON string of dashboard metadata (native filters, filter bar settings, etc.).
- `position_json` (String) JSON string describing the dashboard grid layout.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the dashboard is published (visible to all). Defaults to false.
- `slug` (String) Optional URL-friendly slug for the dashboard.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the dashboard.
- `url` (String) URL path to the dashboard in the Superset UI.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the dashboard assigned by Superset.
